Anna, the weather outside is pleasant and sunny. All conditions are good, so let's go for our walk in the park now.

I understand you’d like me to wake you at 11:30, Anna. Right now the “Wake patient up” activity cannot be started because two conditions are not met:

Once you begin your nap and are actually sleeping, I will be able to set the 11:30 wake‑up alarm for you. Let me know when you’re ready to rest, and I’ll keep an eye on the time so I can wake you up as requested.
